summary.fallback: Find the vindicator who mourns at the shrine. Do not mistake silence for innocence, but do not let fear be your only judge.

return.fallback: Rurik is dead, then. I will not mourn a raider. But I will wonder what died with him.

reward.fallback: Take this. The village pays for dangers ended, even when the ending leaves questions behind.

done.fallback: The shrine road is quiet, and the bread has gone stale.

offer_line.fallback: Rurik No-Banner has been seen near the old shrine road. He carries an axe, but no patrol banner follows him.

target_line.fallback: Keep your distance, village-blade. I left bread, not threats. If they sent you to collect my head, say it plainly.

talk.fallback: Why leave bread at a shrine?
Because four villagers starved in a cellar while my patrol drank beside their burning home. I heard them. I did nothing. Bread is a poor apology to the dead, but it is all my hands know how to leave.
You were part of the raid?
I wore the banner. I swung the axe. Then I saw a child hiding under a cart, and for the first time the shouting sounded like murder instead of victory.
Why should the village spare you?
It should not. But there are captives still held at the outpost because I opened one wrong door and then ran. Let me speak, and I can name where the keys are kept.

attack_choice_label.fallback: Your regrets do not undo the dead.

spare_choice_label.fallback: Speak. One useful truth may buy one breath.

attack_return_line.fallback: You killed him? Then perhaps justice was done. Or perhaps the last man who knew where the captives are has been buried with his shame.

spared_line.fallback: You would let a raider speak? Then listen before courage leaves either of us.

post_spare_line.fallback: The outpost keeps its prison keys beneath the captain's sleeping floor. There is a ledger too, with names taken from the road. Bring them to the village, and I will stand before the bell myself.

villager_spared_line.fallback: You spared him? Then bring back the keys and the ledger he named. If captives truly remain, this village will judge him after they breathe free.

offer_line.fallback: You spared me when the village would have cheered my death. If you still want the truth, there are names buried under outpost stone. Walk with me, and I will show you who I failed.

ambush_player_line.fallback: Raiders rush from the road, drawn by the broken oath.

nothing_line.fallback: I lower my axe, but the words die in my throat before they become a confession.
